title: rechargable salt and pepper shakers, blue light
text: rechargable salt and pepper shakers, blue light. I purchased these rechargable salt and pepper shakers because they came with a charging pad and LED lights. I have 2 rechargable shakers now that I must plug into a USB cord every few weeks - but no light. The problem with these is that the light is BLUE.  It's almost worse than NO light because the blue light is so blue you can't see where or what you are grinding!  The charge pad is handy, but you'll be constantly cleaning it because your shakers sit on the charger base - at the bottoms where the salt and pepper exit.  Also, you must press the button to grind - my current shakers turn on when you flip them - there is a button but no one uses it.  Additionally, the reservoirs for the peppercorns and salt crystals are VERY small.  Eh.  Minus 2 stars for the horrible blue light and another star dock for the way they are designed with the grinder opening on the charger base.  I am searching for a better set, at the very least with a white light.  I cannot recommend this set.  Not sure what I will do with them, probably donate them.  Honestly, one of the most disappointing purchase I have made in a long time.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. All of my reviews reflect my honest, personal experience with the reviewed item - your experience may be different. I am not influenced by any outside source. product_metadata.title: Rechargeable Electric Salt and Pepper Grinder Set with Double Charging Base, Support Battery Operated, Refillable Spice Automatic Mill Shakers Set with Adjustable Coarseness & LED Light
features: 【Rechargeable Pepper Grinder with Double Charge Base】The upgraded electric pepper grinder is different from other manual or usb rechargeable grinders, this electric salt grinder comes with a double charging station. You can charge the grinder directly by putting it into the charge base after use. There is no need to connect the grinder with a usb cable. The charging dock can also accommodate 2 grinders, which can be charged and stored, making your kitchen clean and tidy, provide maximum convenience for you.

【High quality and modern fashion】 High-quality ceramic rotors mean grinding is finely and stable, the original flavor of the seasoning can be maintained.These elegant grinders are ideal for cooking or grilling and make a stylish addition to your kitchen and dining table. Exquisite packaging and modern design pepper grinders make a wonderful gift for housewarming, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Christmas, Birthday, or any other occasion

【Easy to operate】: One tap to turn on the machine, no need to press the switch for a long time during the grinding process, it can be easily operated with one hand. The crushed peppers will stay on the bottom and will be ground first next time you start, so you always get fresh spice instead of peppers that have lost their flavor in the container.

【Adjustable Coarseness】Simply turn the knob on the bottom of the electric salt and pepper grinder to set the desired coarseness, turn clockwise for fine grains and counterclockwise for coarse grains, allowing you to easily control the texture of your spice grinds from coarse to superfine 5 class. Suitable for most solid fragrances. Spices such as sea salt, black pepper, white pepper, etc.

【LED Light & Low Noise 】: Unique LED light design, there is a blue LED light on the bottom of the grinder. With the LED light, you can easily see not only the amount of salt and pepper added to your food, but also the uniformity of the added area. Low noise design, different from other grinders, those kitchen gadgets is very quiet when working. It won't make a lot of noise.
